osc1: shape = sine; freq = d; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
reverb1: size = b; decay = 0.78; damp = f; mix = 1.0; width = 0.95  # reverb
stage2: y = y * (1.0 - e + e * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 1800; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
stage3: y = lerp(x, y, c)  # dry/wet blend

name: Drone Layer
description: Stable feedback drone with LFO level (fb < 0.55) + recovery LPF.
script:
# Drone Layer: Stable feedback drone with LFO level (fb < 0.55) + recovery LPF.
# a Drive: 1 to 3, default 1.6
# b Feedback: 0.08 to 0.52, default 0.28
# c Rate: 0.05 to 1.5, default 0.12

param a = Drive [1.0, 3.0]
param b = Feedback [0.08, 0.52]
param c = Rate [0.05, 1.5]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = c; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = y * (0.75 + 0.25 * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Crystal Edge
description: Air crystal: HPF â†’ softclip blend (soft only) + mild AA LPF.
script:
# Crystal Edge: Air crystal: HPF â†’ softclip blend (soft only) + mild AA LPF.
# a Freq: 1800 to 10000, default 4200
# b Drive: 1.2 to 3.8, default 2.2
# c Blend: 0.25 to 0.75, default 0.5

param a = Freq [1800, 10000]
param b = Drive [1.2, 3.8]
param c = Blend [0.25, 0.75]
bus air:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.5  # highpass
  stage1: y = softclip(x, b)  # soft clip
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 15000; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; air = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Wide Motion
description: Opposite-phase AM L/R for width.
script:
# Wide Motion: Opposite-phase AM L/R for width.
# a Rate: 0.08 to 2.5, default 0.35
# b Depth: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.42
# c Drive: 1 to 2.6, default 1.45

param a = Rate [0.08, 2.5]
param b = Depth [0.15, 0.7]
param c = Drive [1.0, 2.6]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: channel = left; y = tube(x, c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # tube saturation
stage2: channel = right; y = tube(x, c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 - 0.5 * osc1))  # tube saturation

name: Glitch Gate
description: Fast square gate + softclip + mild LPF (gate edges need soft ceiling).
script:
# Glitch Gate: Fast square gate + softclip + mild LPF (gate edges need soft ceiling).
# a Rate: 5 to 28, default 11
# b Depth: 0.65 to 1, default 0.95
# c Drive: 1 to 3, default 1.6

param a = Rate [5.0, 28.0]
param b = Depth [0.65, 1.0]
param c = Drive [1.0, 3.0]
osc1: shape = square; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = softclip(x, c) * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 11000; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Feedback Screamer
description: Controlled feedback (fb capped) â†’ LPF â†’ softclip ceiling (filter before/around clip).
script:
# Feedback Screamer: Controlled feedback (fb capped) â†’ LPF â†’ softclip ceiling (filter before/around clip).
# a Drive: 1.3 to 6, default 3
# b Feedback: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.36
# c LPF: 700 to 7000, default 2800

param a = Drive [1.3, 6.0]
param b = Feedback [0.15, 0.55]
param c = LPF [700, 7000]
stage1: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a)  # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.95  # lowpass
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.2)  # soft clip

name: Fold Universe
description: Deep fold â†’ softclip recovery â†’ lower LPF (fold is HF-heavy; band-limit hard).
script:
# Fold Universe: Deep fold â†’ softclip recovery â†’ lower LPF (fold is HF-heavy; band-limit hard).
# a Drive: 2.5 to 12, default 6.5
# b Fold: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.38
# c Level: 0.25 to 0.9, default 0.55

param a = Drive [2.5, 12.0]
param b = Fold [0.15, 0.7]
param c = Level [0.25, 0.9]
stage1: y = fold(x * a, -b, b)  # wavefold
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.35) * c  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7000; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Noise Blow
description: Env HPF blast into diode sat.
script:
# Noise Blow: Env HPF blast into diode sat.
# a Floor: 120 to 900, default 320
# b Range: 800 to 10000, default 4500
# c Drive: 1.3 to 5.5, default 2.8

param a = Floor [120, 900]
param b = Range [800, 10000]
param c = Drive [1.3, 5.5]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.002; release = 0.18  # envelope follower
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; + = env1; * = b; resonance = 1.2  # highpass
stage1: y = diode(x, c)  # diode clip

name: Formant Crush
description: Dual formant peaks + softclip + mild LPF (clip between formants stays band-limited).
script:
# Formant Crush: Dual formant peaks + softclip + mild LPF (clip between formants stays band-limited).
# a F1: 320 to 1100, default 580
# b F2: 1000 to 2800, default 1500
# c Drive: 1.3 to 4.5, default 2.4

param a = F1 [320, 1100]
param b = F2 [1000, 2800]
param c = Drive [1.3, 4.5]
filter1: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 220  # bandpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, c)  # soft clip
filter2: type = bandpass; center = b; width = 320  # bandpass
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Alien Ring
description: Low-frequency ring mod + tube.
script:
# Alien Ring: Low-frequency ring mod + tube.
# a Freq: 8 to 160, default 32
# b Depth: 0.45 to 1, default 0.85
# c Drive: 1.1 to 4, default 2.1

param a = Freq [8.0, 160.0]
param b = Depth [0.45, 1.0]
param c = Drive [1.1, 4.0]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = tube(x * (1.0 - b + b * osc1), c)  # tube saturation

name: Stutter Gate
description: Extreme square stutter.
script:
# Stutter Gate: Extreme square stutter.
# a Rate: 6 to 36, default 14
# b Depth: 0.75 to 1, default 1

param a = Rate [6.0, 36.0]
param b = Depth [0.75, 1.0]
osc1: shape = square; freq = a; depth = 1.0  # LFO
stage1: y = x * (1.0 - b + b * (0.5 + 0.5 * osc1))  # waveshape / mix

name: Comb Taste
description: Metallic comb via very short delay + high feedback (true delay line, not y_prev).
script:
# Comb Taste: Metallic comb via very short delay + high feedback (true delay line, not y_prev).
# a Time: 3 to 28, default 11
# b Feedback: 0.55 to 0.9, default 0.72
# c Mix: 0.25 to 0.85, default 0.55
# d Drive: 1 to 2.8, default 1.5

param a = Time [3, 28]
param b = Feedback [0.55, 0.9]
param c = Mix [0.25, 0.85]
param d = Drive [1.0, 2.8]
stage1: y = tube(x, d)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = 7000  # delay line
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 10000; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass

name: Preamp Regen Stack
description: HPF -> tube (SIMD) -> ONE y_prev regen stage -> cab LPF -> soft power (SIMD). Fast multi-stage.
script:
# Preamp Regen Stack: HPF -> tube (SIMD) -> ONE y_prev regen stage -> cab LPF -> soft power (SIMD). Fast multi-stage.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 7, default 3.4
# b Regen: 0.08 to 0.48, default 0.28
# c Tone: 800 to 6500, default 3200
# d Level: 0.35 to 1.15, default 0.8

param a = Drive [1.2, 7.0]
param b = Regen [0.08, 0.48]
param c = Tone [800, 6500]
param d = Level [0.35, 1.15]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.4)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.45  # lowpass
stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.15) * d  # soft clip

name: Slapback Drive
description: Touch-sensitive OD into a real short delay slap (80–140 ms), damped feedback, diode polish.
script:
# Slapback Drive: Touch-sensitive OD into a real short delay slap (80–140 ms), damped feedback, diode polish.
# a Drive: 1 to 6.5, default 3
# b Time: 60 to 160, default 105
# c Mix: 0.12 to 0.45, default 0.28
# d Level: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.88

param a = Drive [1.0, 6.5]
param b = Time [60, 160]
param c = Mix [0.12, 0.45]
param d = Level [0.4, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 80; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.75)  # soft clip
delay1: time = b; feedback = 0.18; mix = c; damp = 4200  # delay line
stage2: y = diode(y, 1.15) * d  # diode clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7500; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Cascade Loop Dirt
description: 3-stage dirt: softclip -> feedback tube (only prev stage) -> diode polish + LPF. One scalar stage.
script:
# Cascade Loop Dirt: 3-stage dirt: softclip -> feedback tube (only prev stage) -> diode polish + LPF. One scalar stage.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 9, default 4.2
# b Loop: 0.1 to 0.5, default 0.3
# c Tone: 500 to 6000, default 2800
# d Level: 0.3 to 1.05, default 0.7

param a = Drive [1.5, 9.0]
param b = Loop [0.1, 0.5]
param c = Tone [500, 6000]
param d = Level [0.3, 1.05]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 65; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.45)  # soft clip
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
stage3: y = diode(y, 1.35)  # diode clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.5  # lowpass
stage4: y = softclip(y, 1.05) * d  # soft clip

name: Bass Regen Growl
description: Keep lows: tube pre (SIMD) + single y_prev regen blend + LPF. Low CPU, thick DI.
script:
# Bass Regen Growl: Keep lows: tube pre (SIMD) + single y_prev regen blend + LPF. Low CPU, thick DI.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 2.8
# b Regen: 0.06 to 0.4, default 0.2
# c Blend: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.55
# d Level: 0.5 to 1.25, default 0.95

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.0]
param b = Regen [0.06, 0.4]
param c = Blend [0.2, 0.85]
param d = Level [0.5, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 30; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.5)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = lerp(x, softclip(x + y_prev * b, 1.3), c) * d  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Vocal Warm Loop
description: Broadcast grit with tiny regen for body. HPF -> tube -> mild y_prev softclip -> air LPF.
script:
# Vocal Warm Loop: Broadcast grit with tiny regen for body. HPF -> tube -> mild y_prev softclip -> air LPF.
# a Drive: 1.1 to 4.5, default 2.2
# b Body: 0.04 to 0.32, default 0.14
# c Air: 3000 to 12000, default 8000
# d Level: 0.55 to 1.25, default 0.95

param a = Drive [1.1, 4.5]
param b = Body [0.04, 0.32]
param c = Air [3000, 12000]
param d = Level [0.55, 1.25]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 100; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = softclip(x + y_prev * b, 1.1)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
stage3: y = diode(y, 1.05) * d  # diode clip

name: Drum Bus Regen
description: Bus glue dirt: softclip smash -> controlled y_prev heat -> LPF. One feedback stage only.
script:
# Drum Bus Regen: Bus glue dirt: softclip smash -> controlled y_prev heat -> LPF. One feedback stage only.
# a Drive: 1.3 to 7, default 3.5
# b Heat: 0.08 to 0.45, default 0.22
# c Glue: 1200 to 10000, default 5500
# d Level: 0.4 to 1.1, default 0.78

param a = Drive [1.3, 7.0]
param b = Heat [0.08, 0.45]
param c = Glue [1200, 10000]
param d = Level [0.4, 1.1]
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.6)  # soft clip
stage2: y = hardclip(softclip(x + y_prev * b, 1.2), 0.85)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass
stage3: y = diode(y, 1.1) * d  # diode clip

name: Synth Feedback Lead
description: Lead stack: tube pre -> y_prev scream (capped) -> tone LPF -> soft ceiling. No Osc = max speed.
script:
# Synth Feedback Lead: Lead stack: tube pre -> y_prev scream (capped) -> tone LPF -> soft ceiling. No Osc = max speed.
# a Drive: 1.5 to 8, default 4
# b Feed: 0.12 to 0.52, default 0.32
# c Cutoff: 600 to 7000, default 2800
# d Level: 0.3 to 1, default 0.7

param a = Drive [1.5, 8.0]
param b = Feed [0.12, 0.52]
param c = Cutoff [600, 7000]
param d = Level [0.3, 1.0]
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.55)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.45)  # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.55  # lowpass
stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.2) * d  # soft clip

name: Dual Path Regen
description: Pre softclip (SIMD) + y_prev path blended in ONE stage. Teaches: prev in a single stage only.
script:
# Dual Path Regen: Pre softclip (SIMD) + y_prev path blended in ONE stage. Teaches: prev in a single stage only.
# a Drive: 1.2 to 6.5, default 3.2
# b Regen: 0.1 to 0.5, default 0.28
# c Blend: 0.2 to 0.9, default 0.6
# d Tone: 1000 to 9000, default 5000

param a = Drive [1.2, 6.5]
param b = Regen [0.1, 0.5]
param c = Blend [0.2, 0.9]
param d = Tone [1000, 9000]
stage1: y = softclip(x, a * 0.4)  # soft clip
stage2: y = lerp(x, softclip(x + y_prev * b, a * 0.55), c)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = d; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Tight Metal Regen
description: Tight metal: HPF -> dual tube (SIMD) -> ONE hard-knee regen -> cab LPF. High gain, still hybrid-fast.
script:
# Tight Metal Regen: Tight metal: HPF -> dual tube (SIMD) -> ONE hard-knee regen -> cab LPF. High gain, still hybrid-fast.
# a Gain: 4 to 14, default 8.5
# b Regen: 0.05 to 0.35, default 0.16
# c LowCut: 80 to 300, default 140
# d Level: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.48

param a = Gain [4.0, 14.0]
param b = Regen [0.05, 0.35]
param c = LowCut [80, 300]
param d = Level [0.2, 0.85]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.5  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, a * 0.4)  # tube saturation
stage2: y = tube(y, a * 0.45)  # tube saturation
stage3: y = hardclip(softclip(x + y_prev * b, 1.15), 0.55)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 4800; resonance = 0.55  # lowpass
stage4: y = y * d  # waveshape / mix

name: Tape Echo Dirt
description: Real tape-style echo: tube preamp, medium delay, high feedback, dark damp, soft ceiling.
script:
# Tape Echo Dirt: Real tape-style echo: tube preamp, medium delay, high feedback, dark damp, soft ceiling.
# a Drive: 1.1 to 4, default 2
# b Time: 180 to 520, default 320
# c Feedback: 0.25 to 0.72, default 0.48
# d Age: 800 to 5500, default 2800

param a = Drive [1.1, 4.0]
param b = Time [180, 520]
param c = Feedback [0.25, 0.72]
param d = Age [800, 5500]
stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = b; feedback = c; mix = 0.42; damp = d  # delay line
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.12)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 11000; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Slap Echo
description: Classic slapback: 70–150 ms, low feedback, bright-ish damp — vocals/guitar.
script:
# Slap Echo: Classic slapback: 70–150 ms, low feedback, bright-ish damp — vocals/guitar.
# a Time: 70 to 150, default 105
# b Feedback: 0 to 0.35, default 0.12
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.3
# d Damp: 2500 to 12000, default 7000

param a = Time [70, 150]
param b = Feedback [0.0, 0.35]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
param d = Damp [2500, 12000]
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.08)  # soft clip
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = d  # delay line

name: Eighth Note Echo
description: Tempo-synced 1/8 delay, moderate feedback, ping-pong stereo.
script:
# Eighth Note Echo: Tempo-synced 1/8 delay, moderate feedback, ping-pong stereo.
# a Feedback: 0.2 to 0.65, default 0.4
# b Mix: 0.18 to 0.55, default 0.35
# c Damp: 1000 to 10000, default 5500
# d Drive: 1 to 2.2, default 1.2

param a = Feedback [0.2, 0.65]
param b = Mix [0.18, 0.55]
param c = Damp [1000, 10000]
param d = Drive [1.0, 2.2]
stage1: y = softclip(x, d)  # soft clip
delay1: sync = 1/8; feedback = a; mix = b; damp = c; pingpong = true  # delay line

name: Quarter Dub
description: Tempo 1/4 dub delay: dark damp, long feedback for rhythmic trails.
script:
# Quarter Dub: Tempo 1/4 dub delay: dark damp, long feedback for rhythmic trails.
# a Feedback: 0.4 to 0.85, default 0.62
# b Mix: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.38
# c Damp: 400 to 4000, default 1800
# d Drive: 1 to 3, default 1.55

param a = Feedback [0.4, 0.85]
param b = Mix [0.2, 0.55]
param c = Damp [400, 4000]
param d = Drive [1.0, 3.0]
stage1: y = tube(x, d)  # tube saturation
delay1: sync = 1/4; feedback = a; mix = b; damp = c  # delay line
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 11000; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass

name: Analog Delay
description: Free-time analog-style delay with tube pre and age damp.
script:
# Analog Delay: Free-time analog-style delay with tube pre and age damp.
# a Time: 120 to 700, default 340
# b Feedback: 0.2 to 0.75, default 0.45
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.55, default 0.36
# d Age: 600 to 7000, default 3200

param a = Time [120, 700]
param b = Feedback [0.2, 0.75]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.55]
param d = Age [600, 7000]
stage1: y = tube(x, 1.6)  # tube saturation
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = d  # delay line
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.1)  # soft clip

name: Ping Pong Wide
description: Wide stereo ping-pong at dotted-ish free time with soft pre.
script:
# Ping Pong Wide: Wide stereo ping-pong at dotted-ish free time with soft pre.
# a Time: 180 to 480, default 280
# b Feedback: 0.25 to 0.7, default 0.42
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.5, default 0.34
# d Damp: 1500 to 9000, default 5000

param a = Time [180, 480]
param b = Feedback [0.25, 0.7]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.5]
param d = Damp [1500, 9000]
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.1)  # soft clip
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = d; pingpong = true  # delay line

name: Studio Room
description: Tight recording-room reverb — small size, short decay, musical damp.
script:
# Studio Room: Tight recording-room reverb — small size, short decay, musical damp.
# a Size: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.32
# b Decay: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.35
# c Damp: 0.25 to 0.75, default 0.48
# d Mix: 0.1 to 0.45, default 0.28

param a = Size [0.12, 0.55]
param b = Decay [0.15, 0.55]
param c = Damp [0.25, 0.75]
param d = Mix [0.1, 0.45]
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = c; mix = d; width = 0.75  # reverb

name: Concert Hall
description: Large hall: high size/decay, moderate damp, full width.
script:
# Concert Hall: Large hall: high size/decay, moderate damp, full width.
# a Size: 0.5 to 1, default 0.78
# b Decay: 0.45 to 0.9, default 0.68
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.32
# d Width: 0.6 to 1, default 0.95

param a = Size [0.5, 1.0]
param b = Decay [0.45, 0.9]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.5]
param d = Width [0.6, 1.0]
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.05)  # soft clip
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.32; mix = c; width = d  # reverb

name: Bright Plate
description: Plate-ish: HPF pre, medium room, low damp for air and sheen.
script:
# Bright Plate: Plate-ish: HPF pre, medium room, low damp for air and sheen.
# a Size: 0.3 to 0.75, default 0.5
# b Decay: 0.35 to 0.8, default 0.55
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.55, default 0.35
# d Damp: 0.05 to 0.4, default 0.18

param a = Size [0.3, 0.75]
param b = Decay [0.35, 0.8]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.55]
param d = Damp [0.05, 0.4]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 180; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = d; mix = c; width = 1.0  # reverb

name: Dark Ambient Verb
description: Slow dark pad space: large size, high decay, heavy damp, soft pre.
script:
# Dark Ambient Verb: Slow dark pad space: large size, high decay, heavy damp, soft pre.
# a Size: 0.55 to 1, default 0.82
# b Decay: 0.55 to 0.92, default 0.75
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.4
# d Damp: 0.45 to 0.9, default 0.65

param a = Size [0.55, 1.0]
param b = Decay [0.55, 0.92]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.6]
param d = Damp [0.45, 0.9]
stage1: y = tube(x, 1.25)  # tube saturation
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = d; mix = c; width = 0.9  # reverb
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 9000; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass

name: Drum Chamber
description: Punchy drum chamber: small-medium room, short decay, width for kit.
script:
# Drum Chamber: Punchy drum chamber: small-medium room, short decay, width for kit.
# a Size: 0.2 to 0.6, default 0.38
# b Decay: 0.15 to 0.5, default 0.3
# c Mix: 0.12 to 0.45, default 0.26
# d Width: 0.5 to 1, default 0.85

param a = Size [0.2, 0.6]
param b = Decay [0.15, 0.5]
param c = Mix [0.12, 0.45]
param d = Width [0.5, 1.0]
stage1: y = softclip(x, 1.12)  # soft clip
reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = 0.5; mix = c; width = d  # reverb

name: MS Width
description: True mid/side stereo width: encode, scale side, decode.
script:
# MS Width: True mid/side stereo width: encode, scale side, decode.
# a Width: 0 to 1.6, default 1
# b Level: 0.7 to 1.2, default 1

param a = Width [0.0, 1.6]
param b = Level [0.7, 1.2]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x * b  # waveshape / mix
stage2: channel = side; y = x * a * b  # waveshape / mix
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: MS Mid Focus
description: Compress the mid, leave side open — focused center with width.
script:
# MS Mid Focus: Compress the mid, leave side open — focused center with width.
# a Threshold: -30 to -8, default -18
# b Ratio: 1.5 to 6, default 2.8
# c Side: 0.7 to 1.35, default 1.05
# d Makeup: 0.9 to 1.4, default 1.1

param a = Threshold [-30.0, -8.0]
param b = Ratio [1.5, 6.0]
param c = Side [0.7, 1.35]
param d = Makeup [0.9, 1.4]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x  # waveshape / mix
comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.012; release = 0.16  # compressor
stage2: channel = mid; y = softclip(x * d, 1.08)  # soft clip
stage3: channel = side; y = softclip(x * c, 1.05)  # soft clip
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: MS Side Air
description: HPF the side channel only (channel=side filter) for airy width without muddy mids.
script:
# MS Side Air: HPF the side channel only (channel=side filter) for airy width without muddy mids.
# a SideHPF: 120 to 800, default 280
# b SideGain: 0.6 to 1.4, default 1.05
# c Level: 0.8 to 1.15, default 1

param a = SideHPF [120, 800]
param b = SideGain [0.6, 1.4]
param c = Level [0.8, 1.15]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.35; channel = side  # highpass
stage2: channel = side; y = softclip(x * b, 1.05)  # soft clip
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Clean Boost
description: Clean boost with optional soft ceiling (lerp dry gain vs softclip).
script:
# Clean Boost: Clean boost with optional soft ceiling (lerp dry gain vs softclip).
# a Gain: 1 to 4.5, default 2
# b Soft: 0 to 0.85, default 0.25

param a = Gain [1.0, 4.5]
param b = Soft [0.0, 0.85]
stage1: y = lerp(x * a, softclip(x, a), b)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 16000; resonance = 0.2  # lowpass

name: Mono Punch
description: Stereo-safe mild tube punch + gentle ceiling LPF.
script:
# Mono Punch: Stereo-safe mild tube punch + gentle ceiling LPF.
# a Drive: 1.1 to 4, default 2.1
# b Level: 0.55 to 1.3, default 0.95

param a = Drive [1.1, 4.0]
param b = Level [0.55, 1.3]
stage1: y = tube(x, a) * b  # tube saturation
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 14000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass

name: Safety Clip
description: Safety peak clip: softclip â†’ hard ceiling â†’ high AA LPF (never bare clamp).
script:
# Safety Clip: Safety peak clip: softclip â†’ hard ceiling â†’ high AA LPF (never bare clamp).
# a Ceiling: 0.5 to 1, default 0.94
# b Drive: 1 to 1.8, default 1.08

param a = Ceiling [0.5, 1.0]
param b = Drive [1.0, 1.8]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), a)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 16000; resonance = 0.2  # lowpass

name: Soft Clip Tone
description: Canonical softclip recipe: HPF â†’ softclip(drive) â†’ tone LPF â†’ level.
script:
# Soft Clip Tone: Canonical softclip recipe: HPF â†’ softclip(drive) â†’ tone LPF â†’ level.
# a Drive: 0.8 to 8, default 3
# b Tone: 800 to 9000, default 4500
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.85

param a = Drive [0.8, 8.0]
param b = Tone [800, 9000]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 55; resonance = 0.3  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
stage2: y = y * c  # waveshape / mix

name: Soft-Knee Ceiling
description: Mastering-style peak clip: softclip then hardclip ceiling; gentle AA LPF.
script:
# Soft-Knee Ceiling: Mastering-style peak clip: softclip then hardclip ceiling; gentle AA LPF.
# a Ceiling: 0.6 to 0.99, default 0.92
# b Drive: 1 to 2.5, default 1.15
# c Air: 8000 to 18000, default 14000

param a = Ceiling [0.6, 0.99]
param b = Drive [1.0, 2.5]
param c = Air [8000, 18000]
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, b), a)  # soft clip
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = c; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass

name: Parallel Soft Clip
description: Transparent peaks: lerp(dry, softclip) â€” best when you need control without dirt.
script:
# Parallel Soft Clip: Transparent peaks: lerp(dry, softclip) â€” best when you need control without dirt.
# a Drive: 1 to 5, default 2.2
# b Blend: 0.15 to 0.9, default 0.55
# c Level: 0.6 to 1.15, default 0.95

param a = Drive [1.0, 5.0]
param b = Blend [0.15, 0.9]
param c = Level [0.6, 1.15]
stage1: y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
bus clip:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  stage2: y = softclip(x, a) * c  # soft clip
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 14000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
out: main = 1-b; clip = b  # mix buses back to the output

name: Hard Clip Pedal
description: RAT-style hard character WITHOUT crackle: soft-pre hardclip + tone LPF after.
script:
# Hard Clip Pedal: RAT-style hard character WITHOUT crackle: soft-pre hardclip + tone LPF after.
# a Dist: 1.5 to 10, default 5.5
# b Tone: 400 to 7000, default 2200
# c Level: 0.3 to 1, default 0.65

param a = Dist [1.5, 10.0]
param b = Tone [400, 7000]
param c = Level [0.3, 1.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 65; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = hardclip(softclip(x, a * 0.5), 0.55)  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.55  # lowpass
stage2: y = y * c  # waveshape / mix

name: Diode Clip Stack
description: Diode soft-knee (asinh) + optional soft ceiling + LPF â€” smooth analog-ish clip.
script:
# Diode Clip Stack: Diode soft-knee (asinh) + optional soft ceiling + LPF â€” smooth analog-ish clip.
# a Drive: 1 to 8, default 3.2
# b Tone: 1000 to 10000, default 5500
# c Level: 0.4 to 1.2, default 0.88

param a = Drive [1.0, 8.0]
param b = Tone [1000, 10000]
param c = Level [0.4, 1.2]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 50; resonance = 0.28  # highpass
stage1: y = diode(x, a)  # diode clip
stage2: y = softclip(y, 1.05) * c  # soft clip
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.35  # lowpass

name: Studio Channel Strip
description: Full strip: HPF → soft drive → mid EQ → air LPF → glue comp → soft ceiling.
script:
# Studio Channel Strip: Full strip: HPF → soft drive → mid EQ → air LPF → glue comp → soft ceiling.
# a Drive: 0.8 to 3.5, default 1.35
# b LowCut: 30 to 180, default 55
# c Mid: 400 to 3500, default 1200
# d MidGain: 0.45 to 2, default 1.1
# e High: 4000 to 14000, default 9000
# f Thresh: -28 to -6, default -16

param a = Drive [0.8, 3.5]
param b = LowCut [30, 180]
param c = Mid [400, 3500]
param d = MidGain [0.45, 2.0]
param e = High [4000, 14000]
param f = Thresh [-28.0, -6.0]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.32  # highpass
stage1: y = softclip(x, a)  # soft clip
filter2: type = bandpass; center = c; width = c * 0.5  # bandpass
stage2: y = softclip(x * d, 1.12)  # soft clip
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
comp1: threshold = f; ratio = 3.0; attack = 0.008; release = 0.15  # compressor
stage3: y = softclip(x * 1.0, 1.08)  # soft clip

name: Dual Amp Stack
description: Parallel clean tube + hot tube, mid scoop, cab LPF, presence, level, blend — six-knob dual path.
script:
# Dual Amp Stack: Parallel clean tube + hot tube, mid scoop, cab LPF, presence, level, blend — six-knob dual path.
# a Clean: 0.6 to 2.5, default 1.2
# b Hot: 2 to 9, default 4.5
# c Blend: 0.2 to 0.9, default 0.55
# d Scoop: 0.3 to 1.4, default 0.85
# e Cab: 2500 to 8000, default 4800
# f Level: 0.35 to 1.15, default 0.78

param a = Clean [0.6, 2.5]
param b = Hot [2.0, 9.0]
param c = Blend [0.2, 0.9]
param d = Scoop [0.3, 1.4]
param e = Cab [2500, 8000]
param f = Level [0.35, 1.15]
bus clean:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
  stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation
  filter2: type = bandpass; center = 900; width = 2200  # bandpass
  stage2: y = softclip(x * d, 1.2)  # soft clip
  filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
  stage3: y = softclip(y, 1.1) * f  # soft clip
bus hot:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter4: type = highpass; cutoff = 70; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
  stage4: y = tube(x, b)  # tube saturation
  filter5: type = bandpass; center = 900; width = 2200  # bandpass
  stage5: y = softclip(x * d, 1.2)  # soft clip
  filter6: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
  stage6: y = softclip(y, 1.1) * f  # soft clip
out: clean = 1-c; hot = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Rhythmic Gate Delay
description: Tempo-synced delay + envelope duck + feedback damp + drive on repeats. Complex send FX.
script:
# Rhythmic Gate Delay: Tempo-synced delay + envelope duck + feedback damp + drive on repeats. Complex send FX.
# a Time: 80 to 480, default 220
# b Feedback: 0.15 to 0.88, default 0.48
# c Mix: 0.2 to 0.75, default 0.42
# d Damp: 800 to 9000, default 4200
# e Duck: 0 to 0.9, default 0.45
# f Drive: 0.8 to 4, default 1.6

param a = Time [80, 480]
param b = Feedback [0.15, 0.88]
param c = Mix [0.2, 0.75]
param d = Damp [800, 9000]
param e = Duck [0.0, 0.9]
param f = Drive [0.8, 4.0]
env1: type = peak; attack = 0.008; release = 0.12  # envelope follower
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = 1.0; damp = d  # delay line
stage1: y = softclip(x * (1.0 + f * 0.35), 1.15)  # soft clip
stage2: y = lerp(x, y, c * (1.0 - env1 * e))  # dry/wet blend

name: Cinematic Space
description: Pre-delay → reverb → MS width + air LPF + soft tail ceiling.
script:
# Cinematic Space: Pre-delay → reverb → MS width + air LPF + soft tail ceiling.
# a Predelay: 20 to 180, default 65
# b Size: 0.25 to 0.95, default 0.72
# c Decay: 0.35 to 0.92, default 0.7
# d Damp: 0.15 to 0.85, default 0.45
# e Mix: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.48
# f Width: 0.4 to 1.6, default 1

param a = Predelay [20, 180]
param b = Size [0.25, 0.95]
param c = Decay [0.35, 0.92]
param d = Damp [0.15, 0.85]
param e = Mix [0.2, 0.85]
param f = Width [0.4, 1.6]
delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.05; mix = 0.35; damp = 8000  # delay line
reverb1: size = b; decay = c; damp = d; mix = e; width = 0.95  # reverb
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = 8000; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x  # waveshape / mix
stage2: channel = side; y = x * f  # waveshape / mix
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
stage3: y = softclip(x, 1.08)  # soft clip

name: Phaser Lab
description: LFO-modulated multi-notch cascade with feedback, depth, rate, center, and wet. Advanced swirl.
script:
# Phaser Lab: LFO-modulated multi-notch cascade with feedback, depth, rate, center, and wet. Advanced swirl.
# a Rate: 0.05 to 6, default 0.35
# b Depth: 200 to 2500, default 900
# c Center: 400 to 4000, default 1200
# d Feedback: 0.05 to 0.55, default 0.28
# e Mix: 0.25 to 0.95, default 0.7
# f Resonance: 0.4 to 2.2, default 1.1

param a = Rate [0.05, 6.0]
param b = Depth [200, 2500]
param c = Center [400, 4000]
param d = Feedback [0.05, 0.55]
param e = Mix [0.25, 0.95]
param f = Resonance [0.4, 2.2]
osc1: type = sine; freq = a  # LFO
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus swirl:
  send: main = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  filter1: type = bandpass; center = c + osc1 * b; width = 600; resonance = f  # bandpass
  stage2: y = softclip(x + y_prev * d, 1.2)  # soft clip
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
out: main = 1-e; swirl = e  # mix buses back to the output

name: Vocal Chain Pro
description: Broadcast vocal: de-mud HPF, mild tube, presence BPF, comp, air, de-ess LPF, level.
script:
# Vocal Chain Pro: Broadcast vocal: de-mud HPF, mild tube, presence BPF, comp, air, de-ess LPF, level.
# a LowCut: 60 to 220, default 110
# b Drive: 0.9 to 3.5, default 1.6
# c Presence: 1800 to 5500, default 3200
# d Amount: 0.2 to 0.85, default 0.48
# e Thresh: -24 to -8, default -14
# f Air: 5000 to 14000, default 10000

param a = LowCut [60, 220]
param b = Drive [0.9, 3.5]
param c = Presence [1800, 5500]
param d = Amount [0.2, 0.85]
param e = Thresh [-24.0, -8.0]
param f = Air [5000, 14000]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.35  # highpass
stage1: y = tube(x, b)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = bandpass; center = c; width = 1400  # bandpass
stage2: y = lerp(x, softclip(x, 1.25), d)  # soft clip
comp1: threshold = e; ratio = 3.5; attack = 0.006; release = 0.12  # compressor
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
filter4: type = lowpass; cutoff = 7000; resonance = 0.45  # lowpass
stage3: y = softclip(x * 0.95, 1.08)  # soft clip

name: Bass Architect
description: Sub-safe: HPF, parallel grit, mid focus, comp, low LPF, level. Six knobs for DI design.
script:
# Bass Architect: Sub-safe: HPF, parallel grit, mid focus, comp, low LPF, level. Six knobs for DI design.
# a HPF: 25 to 90, default 40
# b Drive: 1.2 to 6, default 2.8
# c Blend: 0.2 to 0.8, default 0.5
# d Mid: 200 to 1200, default 550
# e Thresh: -22 to -8, default -14
# f Level: 0.5 to 1.3, default 0.95

param a = HPF [25, 90]
param b = Drive [1.2, 6.0]
param c = Blend [0.2, 0.8]
param d = Mid [200, 1200]
param e = Thresh [-22.0, -8.0]
param f = Level [0.5, 1.3]
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.25  # highpass
stage1: y = lerp(x, tube(x, b), c)  # tube saturation
filter2: type = bandpass; center = d; width = d * 0.8  # bandpass
stage2: y = softclip(x * 1.15, 1.1)  # soft clip
comp1: threshold = e; ratio = 4.0; attack = 0.015; release = 0.22  # compressor
filter3: type = lowpass; cutoff = 6500; resonance = 0.3  # lowpass
stage3: y = softclip(x * f, 1.08)  # soft clip

name: Glitch Laboratory
description: Bitcrush + fold + delay ping-pong + LFO LPF + mix. Band-limited; keep OS at 2x.
script:
# Glitch Laboratory: Bitcrush + fold + delay ping-pong + LFO LPF + mix. Band-limited; keep OS at 2x.
# a Bits: 4 to 12, default 8
# b Fold: 0.2 to 0.7, default 0.38
# c Time: 40 to 320, default 140
# d Feedback: 0.1 to 0.65, default 0.35
# e Rate: 0.1 to 4, default 0.8
# f Cutoff: 600 to 8000, default 3200

param a = Bits [4.0, 12.0]
param b = Fold [0.2, 0.7]
param c = Time [40, 320]
param d = Feedback [0.1, 0.65]
param e = Rate [0.1, 4.0]
param f = Cutoff [600, 8000]
osc1: shape = sine; freq = e  # LFO
stage1: y = bitcrush(softclip(x, 1.35), a)  # soft clip
stage2: y = fold(y, -b, b)  # wavefold
delay1: time = c; feedback = d; mix = 0.45; damp = 5000; pingpong = true  # delay line
filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; + = osc1; * = 0.22; resonance = 0.4  # lowpass
stage3: y = lerp(x, softclip(y, 1.08), 0.85)  # soft clip

name: Side Delay
description: MS encode, delay only on the side, decode. Center stays dry — width without smearing a vocal or kick.
script:
# Side Delay: MS encode, delay only on the side, decode. Center stays dry — width without smearing a vocal or kick.
# a Time: 90 to 420, default 220
# b Feedback: 0.12 to 0.62, default 0.32
# c Mix: 0.15 to 0.7, default 0.38
# d Damp: 900 to 7000, default 3800
# e Mid: 0.7 to 1.15, default 1
# f Level: 0.75 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Time [90, 420]
param b = Feedback [0.12, 0.62]
param c = Mix [0.15, 0.7]
param d = Damp [900, 7000]
param e = Mid [0.7, 1.15]
param f = Level [0.75, 1.15]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x * e  # waveshape / mix
delay1: time = a; feedback = b; mix = c; damp = d; channel = side  # delay line
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
stage2: y = softclip(x * f, 1.06)  # soft clip

name: Side Hall
description: Dry stays on main. A bus mutes mid, keeps side, then halls it. Center image stays put.
script:
# Side Hall: Dry stays on main. A bus mutes mid, keeps side, then halls it. Center image stays put.
# a Size: 0.28 to 0.82, default 0.52
# b Decay: 0.28 to 0.8, default 0.5
# c Send: 0.12 to 0.62, default 0.32
# d Damp: 0.25 to 0.8, default 0.48
# e Tone: 3500 to 10000, default 7200
# f Level: 0.75 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Size [0.28, 0.82]
param b = Decay [0.28, 0.8]
param c = Send [0.12, 0.62]
param d = Damp [0.25, 0.8]
param e = Tone [3500, 10000]
param f = Level [0.75, 1.15]
stage1: y = x * f  # waveshape / mix
bus sides:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
  stage2: channel = mid; y = x * 0.0  # mute this channel
  stage3: channel = side; y = x  # waveshape / mix
  ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
  reverb1: size = a; decay = b; damp = d; mix = 1; width = 1.0  # reverb
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
out: main = 1-c; sides = c  # mix buses back to the output

name: Vocal Send
description: Insert or send: dry vocal on main, slap delay bus + small room bus. Two real time blocks, one Send each.
script:
# Vocal Send: Insert or send: dry vocal on main, slap delay bus + small room bus. Two real time blocks, one Send each.
# a Slap: 70 to 170, default 112
# b Size: 0.2 to 0.62, default 0.38
# c Decay: 0.16 to 0.58, default 0.34
# d SlapMix: 0.08 to 0.42, default 0.18
# e RoomMix: 0.1 to 0.52, default 0.24
# f Tone: 3000 to 10000, default 6800

param a = Slap [70, 170]
param b = Size [0.2, 0.62]
param c = Decay [0.16, 0.58]
param d = SlapMix [0.08, 0.42]
param e = RoomMix [0.1, 0.52]
param f = Tone [3000, 10000]
stage1: y = x  # waveshape / mix
bus slap:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  delay1: time = a; feedback = 0.14; mix = 1; damp = 5500  # delay line
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
bus room:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  reverb1: size = b; decay = c; damp = 0.5; mix = 1; width = 0.82  # reverb
  filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
out: main = 1; slap = d; room = e  # mix buses back to the output

name: NY Drum Bus
description: Classic parallel smash: dry kit on main, bus is fast comp + tube + tone LPF. Blend is the mix.
script:
# NY Drum Bus: Classic parallel smash: dry kit on main, bus is fast comp + tube + tone LPF. Blend is the mix.
# a Thresh: -28 to -8, default -16
# b Ratio: 2 to 8, default 4.2
# c Drive: 1.1 to 4, default 2.1
# d Blend: 0.15 to 0.75, default 0.42
# e Tone: 4000 to 12000, default 7800
# f Level: 0.55 to 1.2, default 0.95

param a = Thresh [-28.0, -8.0]
param b = Ratio [2.0, 8.0]
param c = Drive [1.1, 4.0]
param d = Blend [0.15, 0.75]
param e = Tone [4000, 12000]
param f = Level [0.55, 1.2]
stage1: y = x * f  # waveshape / mix
bus smash:
  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  comp1: threshold = a; ratio = b; attack = 0.004; release = 0.09  # compressor
  stage2: y = tube(x, c)  # tube saturation
  filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.28  # lowpass
  stage3: y = softclip(y * f, 1.08)  # soft clip
out: main = 1-d; smash = d  # mix buses back to the output

name: MS Mix Desk
description: MS encode: mid gets optional tube glue, side gets HPF + gain, decode, air LPF. A mix-bus habit, not Ozone.
script:
# MS Mix Desk: MS encode: mid gets optional tube glue, side gets HPF + gain, decode, air LPF. A mix-bus habit, not Ozone.
# a MidDrive: 0.8 to 2.4, default 1.25
# b SideHPF: 90 to 420, default 180
# c Side: 0.7 to 1.35, default 1.05
# d Glue: 0 to 0.7, default 0.28
# e Air: 6000 to 14000, default 11000
# f Level: 0.75 to 1.2, default 1

param a = MidDrive [0.8, 2.4]
param b = SideHPF [90, 420]
param c = Side [0.7, 1.35]
param d = Glue [0.0, 0.7]
param e = Air [6000, 14000]
param f = Level [0.75, 1.2]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = lerp(x, tube(x, a), d)  # tube saturation
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = b; resonance = 0.3; channel = side  # highpass
stage2: channel = side; y = softclip(x * c, 1.05)  # soft clip
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
filter2: type = lowpass; cutoff = e; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
stage3: y = softclip(x * f, 1.06)  # soft clip

name: Mono Below
description: MS encode, high-pass the side at the crossover, decode. Lows collapse to mono; tops keep width.
script:
# Mono Below: MS encode, high-pass the side at the crossover, decode. Lows collapse to mono; tops keep width.
# a Crossover: 70 to 280, default 140
# b Side: 0.5 to 1.3, default 1
# c Mid: 0.85 to 1.15, default 1
# d Level: 0.8 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Crossover [70, 280]
param b = Side [0.5, 1.3]
param c = Mid [0.85, 1.15]
param d = Level [0.8, 1.15]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
stage1: channel = mid; y = x * c  # waveshape / mix
filter1: type = highpass; cutoff = a; resonance = 0.28; channel = side  # highpass
stage2: channel = side; y = softclip(x * b, 1.05)  # soft clip
ms2: mode = decode  # mid/side decode

name: Slap Double

name: MS Presence
description: MS: mid HPF + side HPF, then a parallel presence bus (bandpass mid only) blended back. Does not replace a de-esser.
script:
# MS Presence: MS: mid HPF + side HPF, then a parallel presence bus (bandpass mid only) blended back. Does not replace a de-esser.

# b Amount: 0.12 to 0.55, default 0.28
# c SideHPF: 140 to 600, default 260
# d Side: 0.7 to 1.25, default 1

# f Level: 0.75 to 1.15, default 1

param a = Presence [1800, 5200]
param b = Amount [0.12, 0.55]
param c = SideHPF [140, 600]
param d = Side [0.7, 1.25]
param e = LowCut [70, 200]
param f = Level [0.75, 1.15]
ms1: mode = encode  # mid/side encode

stage1: channel = mid; y = x * f  # waveshape / mix

stage2: channel = side; y = softclip(x * d, 1.04)  # soft clip

  send: in = 1  # feed this bus from the input
  ms3: mode = encode  # mid/side encode
  filter3: type = bandpass; center = a; width = 1400; channel = mid  # bandpass
  stage3: channel = mid; y = softclip(x, 1.18)  # soft clip
  stage4: channel = side; y = x * 0.0  # mute this channel
  ms4: mode = decode  # mid/side decode
  filter4: type = lowpass; cutoff = 12000; resonance = 0.22  # lowpass
out: main = 1; air = b  # mix buses back to the output

script:
# Tension Bed: Slow pulse on a dark hall over mild tube. Underscore bed, not a riser sample.
# a Drive: 0.9 to 2.8, default 1.5
# b Size: 0.4 to 0.88, default 0.64
# c Mix: 0.22 to 0.7, default 0.42
# d Rate: 0.05 to 0.8, default 0.16
# e Depth: 0.12 to 0.5, default 0.28
# f Tone: 2500 to 8000, default 4800

param a = Drive [0.9, 2.8]
param b = Size [0.4, 0.88]
param c = Mix [0.22, 0.7]
param d = Rate [0.05, 0.8]
param e = Depth [0.12, 0.5]
param f = Tone [2500, 8000]

stage1: y = tube(x, a)  # tube saturation

filter1: type = lowpass; cutoff = f; resonance = 0.25  # lowpass
stage3: y = lerp(x, softclip(y, 1.06), c)  # soft clip
